## Action

Pass, unless the forecast clears the Bet365 closing price.

Stake one unit on the over when \(p > 1/o_{\text{over}}\), one unit on the under when \(1 - p > 1/o_{\text{under}}\), and pass otherwise. \(Q\) is the full-time total, in goals. The line is 2.5.

A pass earns 0. A winning unit pays \(o - 1\). A losing unit costs 1. Staking before \(p\) clears the price is the costlier mistake: the overround makes that stake a negative expected profit.

## Reason

The score is mean profit per match against always passing. On the 380 matches from 16 August 2024 through 25 May 2025:

- Poisson strengths: **−0.0039** stake units (standard error 0.0546)
- Training over-rate: **+0.0126** stake units (standard error 0.0555)
- A pass: **0**

The Poisson rule is 0.0164 behind the training over-rate. The standard error of that gap is 0.0451. The two rules tie on 59.7% of matches.

## Risk

A stake the rule places loses the unit **57%** of the time.

The rule stakes on 302 of the 380 matches. A 95% interval for \(p\) crosses a price that would change the stake on 80% of matches.

## Value

A call that already knew the winner would earn **+0.931** stake units per match on these prices.

That is **0.934** more than the Poisson rule. A refit that lets attack and defence change by season is worth keeping only if it moves this profit by more than 0.045 stake units per match.
